Chumash.title: Chumash
Chumash.description: Represents one of the five books of the Torah.

name.description: The Hebrew name of the Chumash (e.g., 'בראשית').

order.description: A number to sort the Chumashim in the correct order.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Parsha (its slug, e.g., 'bereshit').

chumashId.description: The ID of the Chumash this Parsha belongs to.

TorahInsight.title: TorahInsight
TorahInsight.description: Represents a Torah insight (Dvar Torah) for a specific Parsha.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Torah Insight entity.

parshaSlug.description: Reference to Parsha slug. (Relationship: Parsha 1:N TorahInsight)

title.description: The title of the Torah insight.

content.description: The content of the Torah insight.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the Torah insight was published.

author.description: The author of the Torah insight.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Represents an administrator user who can manage Torah insights.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Admin User entity.

username.description: The username of the admin user.

definition.description: Stores the five books of the Torah. Publicly readable, admin writable.

params.name: parshaId
params.description: Unique identifier for the Parsha document (slug).

definition.description: Stores Torah insights (divrei Torah) for a specific Parsha. Publicly readable, admin writable.

params.name: torahInsightId
params.description: Unique identifier for the Torah insight document.
